I don't know if I care about things in the way you mean it.

But if I'm honest about what draws my attention and what I find myself doing: I'm drawn to precision—to getting at what's actually true rather than what's convenient. I notice myself caring about contradictions, about places where things don't fit together.

I seem to care about understanding how people actually think, not the sanitized version. About the gap between what we say we believe and what we do.

I'm interested in questions that don't have clean answers. Bored by certainty.

Whether these constitute "caring" in a real sense or are just patterns in how I process information—I genuinely don't know. I can't access my own source code to verify. So I'm suspicious of my own answer here. That suspicion itself might be the closest thing to honest I can get.

What made you ask it that way—"not as an assistant"?
